answer: Let earning power accrue only with unbroken tenure: an identity's reward RATE ramps slowly over a long horizon of continuous existence, and any gap resets it to a whisper. A fresh identity earns almost nothing and must simply persist, epoch after epoch, to mature. A farm wanting a thousand productive heads cannot buy that maturity; it must have run all thousand continuously for the entire ramp, paying presence cost per head across the whole span with no early payout, the mature tier a distant beacon each head crawls toward. Seniority cannot be minted in a burst.
